request.text: The Grave Keepers buried the Wayfarers who fell on the road, under the oldest trees, where the ground is soft. They noticed that the dead are never seen by the gaze, and they took the undead shard to hide among them. We are among them now. Take the shard and keep walking. We will keep the graves.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 55-65. Excellent quality. Persona: a keeper of graves from a people who buried fallen travellers under the oldest trees, speaking calmly from among the dead. Emotion: calm, hushed, serene, kind, unafraid of death. A low, soft, hushed voice, close and quiet, almost a whisper but warm and steady; every word laid down gently.
